en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Abu Ismail Al Sarraj, from Ibn Muskan, from Abu Baseer who said,
‘Abu Al-Hassanasws the 1st said: ‘When the death presented itself to myasws fatherasws, heasws said to measws: ‘Weasws will not extend ourasws intercession towards the one who takes Salāt’ lightly.
en.sarwar: 15. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn ’Isma‘il from abu ’Isma‘il al-Sarraj from ibn Muskan from abu Basir who has said the following:

“Abu al-Hassan the first, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘When my father was about to pass away he said, “My son, those who consider Salah (prayers) insignificant will not be able to benefit from our intercession.’””
